item.author: Michael Fiorello (@mjfiorello.bsky.social)
item.description: My sister-in-law grew up in Puerto Rico. When I told her about Dolly Parton’s passing, she looked puzzled—no recognition of the golden voice or public persona—until her face lit up and she said, “Oh! The book lady!” I think Dolly would love to be remembered this way by a mother of two.

item.title: When I was a kid, I got free books through Dolly’s Imaginati…
item.author: Mary Kenney (@marykgames.com)
item.description:
When I was a kid, I got free books through Dolly’s Imagination Library. I read this book so often the cover fell off. Steel Magnolias was (and is) one of my favorite movies.

I can’t tell you what it meant to be a poor, artistic kid with Dolly to look up to. RIP Dolly; we’ll always love you
